title: Ya and Todavía with the Pretérito Perfecto

sections.content: You know *ya* and *todavía no* with the *pretérito* *perfecto* from Unit 2. *Ya* says that an action has already happened and *todavía no* says that it has not happened yet: *Ya he contestado*. *Todavía no he enviado el mensaje*.

items.english: I have already answered the message.

items.spanish: Todavía no he enviado el mensaje.
items.english: I have not sent the message yet.

items.spanish: Todavía no ha contestado mi padre.
items.english: My father has not answered yet.

sections.content: Use the two markers to contrast two family members: *Ya ha llamado mi madre, pero todavía no ha contestado mi padre*. Each clause has its own subject and its own marker, and *pero* joins them.
